programme.title: Last Letter [English Subtitle]

programme.title: 200 Pounds Beauty [English Subtitle]

She wants to become a pop-singer, but because she is unattractive, she’s only given opportunities to ghost-sing for a popular singer named Amy. Han-na is also in love with Amy’s producer, Sang-joon, but Sang-joon doesn’t notice her. One day, Han-Na is invited to Sang-Joon’s birthday party and receives a red dress from him to wear to his party. programme.title: My Way [English Dub]

programme.title: Triple Tap [English Subtitle]
